title: RARE-EVO SPECIAL! Copi Cafe Episode 64 | Cornucopias
description:
In this video, we see Farid from Dapp Central stepping into the role of host for CopiCafe, all recorded during the Rare Evo Convention! Alongside him are Cornucopias' Co-CEOs, Rob Greig and Josh Jones, who share their insights on how the convention plays a pivotal role in elevating awareness about Cornucopias. Together, they dive into various subjects, including the recent game build and the significant role of Calido Valley in the overall game development.

As the conversation flows, they also explore the benefits of Web3 technology, offering a glimpse of the promising future it brings. Additionally, they shed light on their upcoming strategies for content creation, giving viewers a sneak peek into what the future holds.

Dapp Central's Youtube link: https://www.youtube.com/@DappCentral

00:00 Beverage Choices
03:37 New Game Build  
09:25 Importance of Calido Valley
13:26 Web 3 Advantages
16:00 Content Creation Plans
17:20 Future Surprises

Fair disclaimer: Copi Leaks are brief glimpses into the game's mechanics as they currently stand. Everything we leak can be assumed to be unfinished, is subject to change, or may never be seen again. So enjoy it while you can, and be sure to share this Copi Leak with everyone you know!

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 

The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 

Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items. 

Linktree: https://linktr.ee/cornucopiasgame
